data.name: Izalun
data.gender_notes: Izalun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Izalun is derived from the Arabic words ‘izal’ which means ‘moon’ and ‘lun’ which means ‘star’. This name signifies the beauty and tranquility of the night sky. The name Izalun carries the meaning “Moon, Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Izalun usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Izalun represents the divine connection between the physical and spiritual realms. It is believed that those named Izalun have a strong intuition and a deep understanding of the universe.
data.etymology: Izalun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izalun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إزالون

in_arabic.long_meaning: إزالون هو اسم مشتق من الفعل أَزالَ، ويعني الرفع و الارتفاع في المعنى و الدلالة. ورد ذكره في بعض التفاسير القرآنية كاسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و العلو.

in_pashto.name: إزالون
in_pashto.meaning: هغه نوم چې په معنی او دلالت کې د لوړتوب او رفعت نښه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: إزالون داسې نوم دی چې د أَزالَ فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او په معنی او دلالت کې د لوړتوب او رفعت نښه کوي. دا نوم په ځینو قرآني تفاسیر کې د الله ښو نومونو څخه یو په توګه ذکر شوی دی، او دا داسې نوم دی چې د رفعت او لوړتوب معاني په ځان کې لري.

in_english.name: Izalun
in_english.meaning: A name indicating elevation and sublimity in meaning and connotation
in_english.long_meaning: Izalun is a name derived from the verb أَزالَ (azāla), which signifies elevation and sublimity in meaning and connotation. The name Izalun reflects a sense of grandeur and spiritual aspiration, embodying the qualities of transcendence and exaltation.
